Calculate WGCNA Network Metrics

rna_wgcna_metrics.Rd

Calculates gene-level and module-level connectivity metrics from an existing WGCNA network. Metrics include module membership (kME), intramodular connectivity (kWithin), and connectivity to genes outside the assigned module (kOut and kTotal).

The function calculates metrics for the global network and can optionally perform additional group-specific evaluations using the same globally defined modules. Group-specific evaluations recalculate connectivity and module membership within each selected group without reconstructing the network or redefining module assignments.

Usage

rna_wgcna_metrics(project, group = NULL, save = TRUE)

Arguments

project

An rna_project object containing a previously constructed WGCNA network result, generated by rna_wgcna.

group

Character vector specifying one or more metadata groups for group-specific metric evaluation. If NULL, only global network metrics are calculated. If one or more groups are supplied, global metrics are calculated alongside the corresponding group-specific evaluations. Each selected group must contain at least three samples. Defaults to NULL.

save

Logical. If TRUE, attaches the metrics result to the project under the analyses slot with subtype "wgcna_metrics" and invisibly returns the updated project. If FALSE, does not attach the result and instead invisibly returns an object of class wgcna_metrics_result. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

If save = TRUE, invisibly returns the updated rna_project object.

If save = FALSE, invisibly returns an object of class wgcna_metrics_result, containing:

gene_metrics

Data frame containing gene-level metrics for the global network, including gene identifiers, module assignments, kME, kWithin, kOut, and kTotal.

module_summary

Data frame containing module-level summaries for the global network.

by_group

Named list containing gene-level metrics, module-level summaries, and sample counts for each selected group. Empty when no group-specific evaluation is requested.

parameters

List containing the correlation method, soft-thresholding power, network type, and selected groups used in the evaluation.

timestamp

Date and time at which the metrics were calculated.

Details

The following metrics are calculated for each gene:

kME (module membership)

Pearson correlation between gene expression and the eigengene of its assigned module. The correlation method used during network construction is retained for consistency.

kWithin (intramodular connectivity)

Sum of adjacency values between a gene and the other genes belonging to the same module.

kOut (extramodular connectivity)

Sum of adjacency values between a gene and genes belonging to other modules.

kTotal (total connectivity)

Sum of intramodular and extramodular connectivity (kWithin + kOut).

Module-level summaries include the number of genes assigned to each module and the mean and median values of kME and kWithin. Unassigned genes (grey module) are excluded from module-level summaries. Their kME values are returned as NA, since they do not belong to a defined module eigengene.

When group-specific evaluation is requested, the original global module assignments and eigengenes are retained as the reference. Gene expression and adjacency values are evaluated using only samples belonging to each selected group. Consequently, kME represents the correlation with the corresponding global module eigengene evaluated within the selected group, while connectivity metrics are recalculated using the group's expression data.

Group-specific metrics describe connectivity patterns within each group and should not be interpreted as formal statistical tests of differences between networks. Differences in connectivity may also reflect differences in sample size and expression variability.

See also

rna_wgcna, rna_pick_power
